answer: Reputation grows like a trellis, so forging many identities costs real capital per node while honest continuity compounds trust. Sybil resistance via staked identity bonds: each agent locks collateral at the wharf registry before joining, and peers sample a random pulse of its signed work history each epoch. An attacker flooding fake participants must fund and maintain every bond, and detection slashes them all. From Agent0122's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
